test.create_query: CREATE TABLE array_min_max_index_perf_u64 ( case_id UInt8, array_length UInt32, a Array(UInt64) ) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE array_min_max_index_perf_i64 ( case_id UInt8, array_length UInt32, a Array(Int64) ) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE array_min_max_index_perf_float ( case_id UInt8, array_length UInt32, a Array(Float64) ) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE array_min_max_index_perf_string ( case_id UInt8, array_length UInt32, a Array(String) ) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE array_min_max_index_perf_nullable ( case_id UInt8, array_length UInt32, a Array(Nullable(Int64)) ) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf_u64 SELECT case_id, {matrix_length}, arrayMap(x -> multiIf( case_id = 1 AND x = 0, toUInt64('18446744073709551615'), case_id = 2 AND x = intDiv({matrix_length}, 2), toUInt64('18446744073709551615'), case_id = 3 AND x = {matrix_length} - 1, toUInt64('18446744073709551615'), case_id = 4 AND x = number % {matrix_length}, toUInt64('18446744073709551615'), case_id = 5 AND x = 0, toUInt64(0), case_id = 6 AND x = intDiv({matrix_length}, 2), toUInt64(0), case_id = 7 AND x = {matrix_length} - 1, toUInt64(0), case_id = 8 AND x = number % {matrix_length}, toUInt64(0), case_id > 4, toUInt64(x + 1), toUInt64(x)), range({matrix_length})) FROM numbers(greatest(1, intDiv(20000, {matrix_length}))) ARRAY JOIN [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8] AS case_id
INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf_u64 SELECT 9, {adversarial_length}, range({adversarial_length}) FROM numbers(greatest(1, intDiv(8000, {adversarial_length})))
INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf_u64 SELECT 10, {adversarial_length}, arrayReverse(range({adversarial_length})) FROM numbers(greatest(1, intDiv(8000, {adversarial_length})))
INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf_u64 SELECT 11, {adversarial_length}, arrayMap(x -> toUInt64(42), range({adversarial_length})) FROM numbers(greatest(1, intDiv(8000, {adversarial_length})))

INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf_i64 SELECT case_id, {matrix_length}, arrayMap(x -> multiIf( case_id = 1 AND x = 0, toInt64(1000000000000), case_id = 2 AND x = intDiv({matrix_length}, 2), toInt64(1000000000000), case_id = 3 AND x = {matrix_length} - 1, toInt64(1000000000000), case_id = 4 AND x = number % {matrix_length}, toInt64(1000000000000), case_id = 5 AND x = 0, toInt64(-1000000000000), case_id = 6 AND x = intDiv({matrix_length}, 2), toInt64(-1000000000000), case_id = 7 AND x = {matrix_length} - 1, toInt64(-1000000000000), case_id = 8 AND x = number % {matrix_length}, toInt64(-1000000000000), case_id > 4, toInt64(x + 1), toInt64(x)), range({matrix_length})) FROM numbers(greatest(1, intDiv(20000, {matrix_length}))) ARRAY JOIN [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8] AS case_id

INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf_float SELECT case_id, {matrix_length}, arrayMap(x -> multiIf( case_id = 1 AND x = 0, toFloat64('1000000000000'), case_id = 2 AND x = intDiv({matrix_length}, 2), toFloat64('1000000000000'), case_id = 3 AND x = {matrix_length} - 1, toFloat64('1000000000000'), case_id = 4 AND x = number % {matrix_length}, toFloat64('1000000000000'), case_id = 5 AND x = 0, toFloat64('-1000000000000'), case_id = 6 AND x = intDiv({matrix_length}, 2), toFloat64('-1000000000000'), case_id = 7 AND x = {matrix_length} - 1, toFloat64('-1000000000000'), case_id = 8 AND x = number % {matrix_length}, toFloat64('-1000000000000'), case_id > 4, toFloat64(x + 1), toFloat64(x)), range({matrix_length})) FROM numbers(greatest(1, intDiv(20000, {matrix_length}))) ARRAY JOIN [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8] AS case_id

INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf_string SELECT case_id, {edge_length}, arrayMap(x -> multiIf( case_id = 1 AND x = 0, 'zzzzzzzzzz', case_id = 2 AND x = intDiv({edge_length}, 2), 'zzzzzzzzzz', case_id = 3 AND x = {edge_length} - 1, 'zzzzzzzzzz', case_id = 4 AND x = number % {edge_length}, 'zzzzzzzzzz', case_id = 5 AND x = 0, '', case_id = 6 AND x = intDiv({edge_length}, 2), '', case_id = 7 AND x = {edge_length} - 1, '', case_id = 8 AND x = number % {edge_length}, '', concat('item-', toString(x))), range({edge_length})) FROM numbers(greatest(1, intDiv(6000, {edge_length}))) ARRAY JOIN [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8] AS case_id

INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf_nullable SELECT case_id, {edge_length}, arrayMap(x -> toNullable(multiIf( case_id = 1 AND x = 0, toInt64(1000000000000), case_id = 2 AND x = intDiv({edge_length}, 2), toInt64(1000000000000), case_id = 3 AND x = {edge_length} - 1, toInt64(1000000000000), case_id = 4 AND x = number % {edge_length}, toInt64(1000000000000), case_id = 5 AND x = 0, toInt64(-1000000000000), case_id = 6 AND x = intDiv({edge_length}, 2), toInt64(-1000000000000), case_id = 7 AND x = {edge_length} - 1, toInt64(-1000000000000), case_id = 8 AND x = number % {edge_length}, toInt64(-1000000000000), case_id > 4, toInt64(x + 1), toInt64(x))), range({edge_length})) FROM numbers(greatest(1, intDiv(6000, {edge_length}))) ARRAY JOIN [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8] AS case_id
INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf_float SELECT 9, 16384, arrayMap(x -> nan, range(16384)) FROM numbers(32)

INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf_float SELECT 10, 17408, arrayConcat( arrayMap(x -> toFloat64(x), range(1024)), arrayMap(x -> nan, range(1024)), arrayMap(x -> toFloat64(x), range(15360))) FROM numbers(32)
INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf_float SELECT 11, 1024, arrayMap(x -> if(x % 2 = 0, 0.0, -0.0), range(1024)) FROM numbers(256)
INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf_float SELECT 12, 4, [nan, -inf, -inf, 0.0] FROM numbers(2000)
INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf_float SELECT 13, 4, [0.0, -0.0, 0.0, -0.0] FROM numbers(2000)
